title: phleum michelii subsp. ambiguum
intro: Phleum michelii subsp. ambiguum, commonly known as Timothy grass or False Timothy, is a perennial grass species that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of allergies and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Timothy grass include soothing and calming effects, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress and anxiety relief. The bioactive constituents of Phleum michelii subsp. ambiguum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
